rules.expectation: The selected adapter identifier is admitted by the resolved compiled Profile.
rules.meaning: A Profile explicitly declares which compiled adapters may project its notation.
rules.action: Select an admitted adapter or update the compiled Profile contract.

rules.expectation: The selected adapter notation exactly equals the resolved compiled Profile notation.
rules.meaning: Adapter and Profile must describe the same notation family before projection.
rules.action: Select a matching adapter and Profile pair.

rules.expectation: Every compiled Profile has a unique identity and token pair in the static inventory.
rules.meaning: A Profile reference must resolve to at most one immutable compiled descriptor.
rules.action: Remove the duplicate compiled Profile identity or token.

rules.expectation: The model Profile reference conforms to the canonical identity-at-token grammar.
rules.meaning: Canonical syntax makes Profile selection exact and deterministic.
rules.action: Write the reference as the exact compiled Profile identity followed by @ and its token.

rules.expectation: The model root declares exactly one O2I Profile reference.
rules.meaning: Operation cannot select a Profile without an explicit model-level reference.
rules.action: Add one o2i.profile property to the model root.

rules.expectation: The model root contains exactly one o2i.profile property occurrence.
rules.meaning: Multiple Profile properties make the model-level selection ambiguous.
rules.action: Retain one authoritative o2i.profile property occurrence.

rules.expectation: The model Profile reference exactly identifies one descriptor in the compiled inventory.
rules.meaning: Only compiled Profiles can supply executable mapping and validation contracts.
rules.action: Use an exact reference reported by the profiles discovery command.

rules.expectation: The o2i.profile property contains one textual scalar value.
rules.meaning: Profile resolution consumes one canonical textual reference rather than structured or numeric data.
rules.action: Replace the property value with one textual Profile reference.

rules.expectation: The o2i.profile property contains exactly one value occurrence.
rules.meaning: Multiple values would request more than one Profile for the same model.
rules.action: Retain one authoritative Profile reference value.
